newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers steady despite barge gains.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers steady despite barge gains.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were barely changed on Monday despite barge market gains, while prices in the Med and Middle East softened, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers were quoted at around $86 fob, barely changed from Friday, although barges trade reached that level before retreating slightly.
Traders said volumes in both the barge and bunker markets were very thin. Bunker market trade amounted to some 5,000 tonnes, most of which were supplied by majors.
Hamburg bunkers were similarly quiet and also unchanged, at around $93 fob.
In the Mediterranean, prices were mostly down by around $2 a tonne, except for southern France, where prices rose by $2. All ports were quiet.
Egyptian fuel oil bunkers by also softened. As on Friday, Port Said was dry and Alexandria deliveries subject to enquiries.
